entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloFit Pro-Weave Jersey. What specifically is the issue with the item?
Well, it's just the wrong size. I was so excited when I ordered it, but I got busy and never tried it on. I feel so silly. I'm a loyal customer and I'm just hoping it's not too late.
I understand. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the jersey, or is it just a matter of preference with the fit?
It's just the fit. It's way too tight. I was really counting on that money back if it didn't work out... I'm really hoping you can help me.
Let me check the purchase date for you. I see you received this 80 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Okay, I have good news for you. That jersey is one of our standard items, and it falls under our 90-day return policy. You are still within the window, so we can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Now, would you prefer a refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a different size?
An exchange would be perfect, actually. I really love the jersey, I just need the next size up.

Not a problem at all. I have initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid return label. Just package the original item and drop it off, and we'll send the new size out as soon as we get tracking confirmation on the return.
That's fantastic. You've been a huge help, Diana.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
